channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Paul Allen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Paul Allen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Paul Allen, Bert Kolde, Terry Stotts, Chris McGowan
item.description:
“I am honored to extend my tenure with the Portland Trail Blazers under the leadership of Jody Allen, the ongoing partnership with Bert Kolde, Chris McGowan and Terry Stotts and in the memory of Paul G. Allen,”

Neil Olshey on Paul Allen, Bert Kolde, Terry Stotts, Chris McGowan, May 24, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Paul Allen
item.description:
“But life throws you different types of stress, different trials and tribulations, and you have to figure out how to get through it. We all go through that process of feeling sorry for ourselves, but then you have to get over that and move forward. For me, I know our job is to perform. And Nurk wouldn’t want us to just lay down. Mr. Allen wouldn’t want us to lay down and throw in the towel. So, you just press on.”

CJ McCollum on Paul Allen, Apr 4, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Paul Allen
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Terry Stotts on what he’ll be thinking during tonight’s @Paul Allen tribute:

“What an extraordinary man he was, not only in sports but in the world in general. I’ll be thinking about the impact he has had on lives around the world beyond basketball. It was a phenomenal life.”

Terry Stotts on Paul Allen, Oct 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Paul Allen
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on passing of Paul Allen (2/2):

“Our condolences go out to his family, friends, colleagues & the Trail Blazers fans.”

Jeanie Buss on Paul Allen, Oct 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Paul Allen
item.description:
#Lakers owner Jeanie Buss on passing on #Blazers owner Paul Allen (1/2):

“We are terribly saddened by the news of the passing of Paul Allen. He was dedicated to the city of Portland & his Trail Blazers teams reflected his commitment to hard work & excellence.”

Jeanie Buss on Paul Allen, Oct 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Paul Allen
item.description:
“This extension is a validation of the efforts of the entire Trail Blazers front office and an endorsement of the level of commitment expected of us by our owner Paul Allen,”

Neil Olshey on Paul Allen, Jan 8, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jamal Crawford on Paul Allen
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Jamal Crawford on Paul Allen:

“He's a cool owner... I read his book before I came here... He lives across the water from me in Seattle.”

Jamal Crawford on Paul Allen, Dec 20, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Clement Uduk on Paul Allen
item.description:
“At this point now, I've been dealing with that thought pretty much the entire day. What happens when I get that call from Mr. Oxley or for all I know Paul Allen? Or AEG could come talk to me, there could be major ramifications but I get that.”

Clement Uduk on Paul Allen, Oct 25, 2011. Source: CHARGED.fm.
